Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on annual leave carry-over at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
A maximum of 10 unused vacation days can be carried over and must be taken before 30 June.
Validity
Version 1.2, effective 2021-07-01. Next review: 2023-09-21.
